title: Help: Custom JS/CSS to toggle Activity/Comments not applying (Frappe v15)

posts.name: Daniel Vishna
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone,

I’m trying to add a custom button to all forms (like Projects, Doctype forms, etc.) to toggle the visibility of the Activity and Comments sections. I aim to have them hidden by default, and only show them when a user clicks the button.

I have a custom app called *, and this is what I’ve done:

1. In aboulafia/hooks.py: I’m loading my custom assets globally:

Python

app_include_css = ["/assets/*/css/custom_styles.css"]
app_include_js  = ["/assets/*/js/custom_ui.js"]

2. My */public/css/custom_styles.css file: This file is intended to hide the sections by default. It will only show them if the wrapper has the class aboulafia-show-activity.

CSS

/* --- Global hide for Activity/Comments --- */
.form-comments,
.comment-box,
.timeline,
.timeline-wrapper,
.frappe-timeline,
.form-timeline,
.document-activity,
#timeline,
.card-section:has(.form-comments),
.card-section:has(.timeline),
.frappe-card:has(.form-comments),
.frappe-card:has(.timeline) {
	display: none !important;
}

/* --- Show them when class is added --- */
.aboulafia-show-activity .form-comments,
.aboulafia-show-activity .comment-box,
.aboulafia-show-activity .timeline,
.aboulafia-show-activity .timeline-wrapper,
.aboulafia-show-activity .frappe-timeline,
.aboulafia-show-activity .form-timeline,
.aboulafia-show-activity .document-activity,
.aboulafia-show-activity #timeline,
.aboulafia-show-activity .card-section:has(.form-comments),
.aboulafia-show-activity .card-section:has(.timeline),
.aboulafia-show-activity .frappe-card:has(.form-comments),
.aboulafia-show-activity .frappe-card:has(.timeline) {
	display: block !important;
}

3. My */public/js/custom_ui.js file: This script is supposed to add a toggle button to every form.

JavaScript

frappe.ui.form.on("*", {
    refresh: function(frm) {
        const button_id = "toggle_activity_btn";
        if (frm.custom_buttons[button_id]) {
            // Update existing button text
            const is_visible = frm.wrapper.classList.contains("aboulafia-show-activity");
            frm.custom_buttons[button_id].text(is_visible ? __("Hide Activity") : __("Show Activity"));
            return;
        }

        // Add new button
        frm.add_custom_button(__("Show Activity"), function() {
            frm.wrapper.classList.toggle("aboulafia-show-activity");
            const is_visible = frm.wrapper.classList.contains("aboulafia-show-activity");
            frm.custom_buttons[button_id].text(is_visible ? __("Hide Activity") : __("Show Activity"));
        }, {
            "name": button_id
        });
    }
});

The Problem:

After making these changes, I ran bench build (which completed successfully) and bench restart.

However, the Activity section is still visible by default, and my new “Show Activity” button does not appear on the form.

It seems like my new custom_styles.css and custom_ui.js Files are not being loaded or applied at all.

I have already tried:

  • Running bench clear-cache.

  • Hard refreshing the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R).

  • Running bench build again.

During the build, I did see this warning: WARN Cannot connect to redis_cache to update assets_json. Could this be the reason my new assets aren’t loading?

Does anyone know how to fix this and load my custom scripts?

Many thanks for considering my request.
